datasets.name: Rests
datasets.sql:
SELECT id,
       dateofcredit, 
       sum(namount), 
       sum(navgintamount), 
       sum(famount), 
       sum(favgintamount),
       sum(fnamount), 
       sum(fnavgintamount)
  FROM cm_rests_sd
group by id , dateofcredit

datasets.sql:
select 1 ,
       'Hesabat dövrünün əvvəlinə kreditlər - cəmi' ,

       sum(navgintamount)/cm_sd.get_divzero(sum(namount)),
